summary: The United States has declared the ceasefire with Iran over while agreeing to continue talks, as President Trump threatens massive retaliation if Iran attempts to assassinate him. Israel continues targeted killings of Hamas commanders in northern Gaza and Hezbollah operatives in southern Lebanon's Ali Taher ridge, while planning new settlements in northern Gaza. Regional tensions rise with US demands for Iran to open the Strait of Hormuz, Iraqi and Lebanese funeral processions for Khamenei, and internal security incidents in Israel and Iran.
key_points: US declares ceasefire with Iran over but agrees to continue talks, while Trump threatens massive bombing if Iran assassinates him. (Source: @shin_persian/7634)
Satellite imagery reveals Iranian repair work at Parchin's Telghan 2 nuclear facility after US-Israeli strikes, indicating possible violation of understandings. (Source: @asafroz/51266)
IDF eliminates Hamas production commander in northern Gaza and Nuseirat battalion platoon commander in separate strikes. (Source: @inon_yttach/9361)
IDF kills Hezbollah operative near underground infrastructure at Ali Taher ridge in Lebanon, prevents group from exiting tunnels. (Source: @New_security8200/202404)
Israeli Finance Minister Smotrich announces plans for three new Israeli towns in northern Gaza Strip. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/75453)
US demands Iran publicly declare Strait of Hormuz open and halt attacks on commercial vessels ahead of Iran-Oman talks. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/4815)
Two Basij members killed in armed attack on inspection station in Mashhad following Khamenei's burial. (Source: @mamlekate/103858)

sections.executive_summary: The United States has declared the ceasefire with Iran over while agreeing to continue technical talks, with President Trump warning of massive bombing if Iran attempts to assassinate him. Israel is conducting simultaneous operations against Hamas in Gaza and Hezbollah in Lebanon, eliminating senior commanders and preventing tunnel exits at Ali Taher ridge, while advancing plans for new settlements in northern Gaza. Regional pressure mounts as the US demands Iran guarantee freedom of navigation in the Strait of Hormuz, and internal security threats emerge in both Israel and Iran.

points: The United States has declared the ceasefire with Iran over but agreed to continue technical talks, while President Trump stated he has ordered massive bombing to "levels they haven't seen before" if Iran assassinates him, confirming he has been Iran's "number one" target for a long time. (Source: @shin_persian/7634, @kianmeli1/88676)

New satellite imagery from June 22 and July 7 shows extensive repair and reconstruction at the Parchin military complex's Telghan 2 facility, where nuclear weapon explosives are stored and past nuclear weaponization tests occurred, following US and Israeli strikes. (Source: @asafroz/51266, @lelotsenzura/93479)

Iran's Foreign Ministry spokesman Baqaei denied Tehran requested talks with Washington, asserting policy remains "commitment for commitment" and warning any US violation will face reciprocal action, while Mohammad Marandi, close to the negotiating team, said no talks will occur unless the Trump administration fulfills its commitments. (Source: @SharghDaily/171123, @rodast_omiddana/75444)

Rosatom reported the first group of six Bushehr nuclear power plant workers has returned to the facility, and a memorial ceremony for Ayatollah Khamenei was held in Bushehr. (Source: @kianmeli1/88670, @presstv/198143)

Two Basij members were killed and several wounded in an armed attack on an inspection station in Mashhad's Serafrazan neighborhood hours after Khamenei's burial, which authorities described as a personal dispute. (Source: @mamlekate/103858)
A sign reading "We will kill Trump" appeared on a building in Mashhad, and Iran strongly condemned terrorist attacks in Pakistan. (Source: @lelotsenzura/93478, @presstv/198116)

The UN Security Council meeting on Iran's nuclear file yielded no result, and Sayyid Ali Khamenei stated current negotiations are not peace talks, the country is at war, and anyone negotiating peace with America is a traitor. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/376058, @rasedal3ado138e/376069)

The IDF eliminated Hamas production headquarters commander Khalil Jamal Khalil Manaa in northern Gaza and Nuseirat battalion platoon commander Osama Walid Dib Mahareb in a separate strike. (Source: @inon_yttach/9361)

IDF forces killed a Hezbollah operative operating near an underground infrastructure shaft at Ali Taher ridge in southern Lebanon and eliminated a suspect in a vehicle posing a threat, while preventing Hezbollah from exiting tunnels in the ridge. (Source: @New_security8200/202404, @N12chat/216836)
Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich announced plans to build three Israeli towns in the northern Gaza Strip. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/75453)

Four Bedouins from Segev Shalom and the Negev were charged with planning a mass shooting at the Be'er Sheva central bus station and police stations; one was designated commander, another "engineer" with a bomb-making guide, and they posted Hamas propaganda and calls for jihad. (Source: @almogboker78/17692, @amitsegal/62941)
The Shin Bet confirmed investigating a leak regarding an operation in Iran but denied any connection to a meeting between the Shin Bet chief and a Channel 14 commentator. (Source: @amitsegal/62948)
US officials urged Israel not to join the current escalation with Iran, fearing Israeli involvement could spiral the conflict out of control. (Source: @pkpoi/143229)

Tax benefits will be extended to 64 West Bank settlements starting next month, and two people were injured in a criminal violence incident in Al-Eizariya. (Source: @yediotnews25/132503, @N12chat/216841)
The IDF eliminated two Hamas commanders in northern Gaza and the Nuseirat battalion, continuing targeted killings of mid-level military leadership. (Source: @inon_yttach/9361)
Israeli Finance Minister Smotrich revealed plans to establish three new Israeli towns in northern Gaza, signaling long-term territorial intentions. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/75453)
The Israeli government approved tax benefits for 64 West Bank settlements effective next month. (Source: @yediotnews25/132503)
Two Palestinians were injured, one seriously, in a criminal violence incident in Al-Eizariya in the West Bank. (Source: @N12chat/216841)
Satellite imagery shows extensive destruction across Gaza, with before-and-after comparisons circulating. (Source: @kianmeli1/88675)

IDF forces killed a Hezbollah operative near an underground infrastructure shaft at Ali Taher ridge in the security zone, and eliminated a suspect in a vehicle, while preventing Hezbollah from exiting tunnels and moving in the ridge area. (Source: @New_security8200/202404)
A drone strike on a vehicle in Shukin, Nabatieh district, caused two casualties according to Lebanese channels. (Source: @yediotnews25/132511)
Warplanes were observed flying over south Lebanon and the Beqaa Valley at maximum alert levels. (Source: @redlinkleb/30898, @redlinkleb/30842)
Mapping focus indicates heightened attention on Nabatieh al-Fawqa and Nabatieh al-Tahta areas. (Source: @redlinkleb/30871)
President Trump stated Syria could help confront Hezbollah, suggesting potential regional realignment. (Source: @naya_foriraq/82323)
Millions of Iraqis participated in a massive funeral procession for Ayatollah Khamenei in Baghdad, demonstrating Iran's influence. (Source: @naya_foriraq/82324)
A fire broke out at the Dublin base near Baghdad International Airport. (Source: @naya_foriraq/82330)

German journalist Eva Maria Michlmann, detained for six months in HTS (Hay'at Tahrir al-Sham) prisons in Syria, warned at a press conference in Germany that the HTS government is not democratic in any form. (Source: @naya_foriraq/82343)
Malian authorities accused Ukraine of training and arming Al-Qaeda-linked militants in the Sahel with drones. (Source: @presstv/198139)
Trump suggested Syria could assist in confronting Hezbollah, indicating possible US-Syria cooperation against the group. (Source: @naya_foriraq/82323)

Qatar's sovereign wealth fund, holding 10.4% of Volkswagen and 12.3% of Hapag-Lloyd, blocked a Volkswagen-Rafael deal for Iron Dome components and the Hapag-Lloyd acquisition of Israeli shipping company Zim. (Source: @asafroz/51256)

Turkey may sell its S-400 air defense systems to a Gulf state, with UAE and Qatar mentioned as candidates seeking defense against Iran, a move the US might approve since they lack F-35s. (Source: @asafroz/51253, @Faytuks_Network/4805)

The US demanded Iran publicly declare the Strait of Hormuz open and commit to halting attacks on commercial vessels ahead of Saturday Iran-Oman talks, warning of "serious consequences" if refused. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/4815)
The UAE ambassador to the US appeared on stage with former Prime Minister Bennett and Jared Kushner at a conference in Idaho. (Source: @amitsegal/62946)
